illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableParty: Show the party portrait rail on the left side of the screen.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableTurnT: Show the initiative carousel at the top of the screen during combat.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableActio: Show Midi-QOL action economy, movement, and ability buttons on the current-token panel.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableMobil: On phones/tablets, Illusive runs sheet-only (no canvas) with its own character carousel.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.mobil: Client mode, background image, and UI accent for the mobile sheet.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.mobileClien: Auto detects phones/tablets. Force Mobile always uses the sheet-only client; Force Desktop always loads the full HUD (useful for testing).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.mobileBackg: Show a background behind the sheet-only mobile client. Turn off for a solid dark screen.
Browse/load an image for sheet-only mode (FilePicker). Leave empty for the default dark vignette.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.mobileAccen: Your personal accent color for the Illusive mobile sheet. Only affects your client.
illusive-combat-hud.mobile.noActors: No owned characters available for the Illusive mobile sheet.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableTurnH: When the turn changes on this client: GM clears canvas selection and pans to the active token; other players pan on desktop; touch-table clients never auto-pan (HUD focus only). Each user controls their own preference.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.displ: Match HUD proportions to your monitor. Auto scales from a 2560×1440 landscape reference, or 1080×1920 for portrait / Vizio tabletops.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.displayProf: Auto follows the current window size. Vizio Portrait matches a 1080p extended display rotated tall. Locked presets scale as if that resolution were active.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.touchTableC: For the shared touchscreen map client. Auto enables on touch devices (non-GM): tap one token to focus the HUD without owning it; panning clears canvas selection so the map moves instead of every token. Tap empty map to clear focus.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.party: GM defaults for party portrait display. Players can personalize rail position and their own card.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.turnT: Configure the initiative carousel and turn card display.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.actio: Configure token statuses, action bar animation, reactions, and Midi dialogs.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showResourc: Display a resource bar on the current-token panel when the actor has a detectable resource.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showPartyCo: Highlight the active turn on party portraits during combat.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.preferHudRe: Optional. When off, Midi-QOL handles reaction prompts (Counterspell, opportunity attacks, etc.) with its own dialog.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.midiConfigu: Show Midi item configuration dialogs when using abilities from the action bar. Off keeps clicks fast and canvas-driven.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.hideHotbarW: Hide Macro Bar and Player List
Legacy setting. Foundry's macro bar, player list, and FPS are always hidden while the action bar is expanded, and restored when you tuck the bar away.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableToken: Show active effect icons for the selected token.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.tokenStatus: Effect icons always appear in a strip at the top right.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.turnTracker: Maximum number of combatant cards visible at once (1–16). Cards are never cut off; on smaller windows fewer may fit so the tracker stays clear of the sidebar.
Let the carousel scroll to preview upcoming turns through the next round. When off, only the max number of cards is shown with no scrolling.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.partyOffset: Pixels to shift the party portrait rail left (negative) or right (positive).
Pixels to shift the party portrait rail down (negative) or up (positive).
Scale percentage for the party portrait rail (75–125).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.tokenOffset: Extra pixels to shift the action bar left (negative) or right (positive).
Extra pixels to shift the action bar down (negative) or up (positive).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.hudTheme.hi: BG3 uses ornate frames and warm accents. Minimal uses flat panels.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showOrnateF: Show decorative portrait frames on party and turn tracker cards.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showTokenAc: Show armor class and walk speed on the current-token panel.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showTokenTe: Show a separate blue segment for temporary hit points on the HP bar.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.colorHpBarB: Tint HP bars green, yellow, or red based on remaining health.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showYourTur: Show a banner on the current-token panel when it is your combat turn.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showResourc: Show the resource name on the current-token resource bar.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.tokenPanelO: Opacity percentage for the current-token panel (50–100).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.partySize.h: Portrait dimensions for the party rail (compact, normal, or large).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.partyMaxPor: Maximum portraits visible before the rail scrolls (1–8). Default is 4.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.partyScroll: Allow scrolling when there are more portraits than the max shown.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showPartyNa: Show character names on party portrait cards.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.damageWashB: Only show the red damage wash on portraits when current HP is at half or lower. When off, the wash tracks remaining HP at any health level (party-style).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.hudAnimatio: Animate the action bar when collapsing or expanding. Turn off for an instant toggle.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.partyRailOp: Opacity percentage for the party portrait rail (50–100).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.hideDefeate: Remove defeated combatants from the initiative carousel for players. The GM still sees them (styled as defeated).
illusive-combat-hud.settings.carouselTur: Slide the initiative carousel in the direction of travel when the turn advances or goes back.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showTurnCar: Show current/max HP text on initiative portrait cards. Players still see health status wash without numbers when this is off.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.showEnemyHp: Legacy setting. Enemy health status is always visible to players.
illusive-combat-hud.partyPlayerPrefs.rai: Adjust where the party rail appears on your screen. GM defaults apply when unchanged.
illusive-combat-hud.partyPlayerPrefs.myC: Override how your owned player character appears on the party rail. Other portraits use GM defaults.
illusive-combat-hud.partyPlayerPrefs.min: Collapse the party rail on your screen.
illusive-combat-hud.partyPlayerPrefs.sho: Highlight your portrait when it is your combat turn.
illusive-combat-hud.movement.gestalt: Shared movement pool (walk, fly, swim, etc.)
illusive-combat-hud.turn.notYourTurn: It is not this token's turn.
illusive-combat-hud.warnings.noOwner: You do not own this token.
illusive-combat-hud.warnings.gmOnly: Only the GM can do that.
illusive-combat-hud.empty.outOfCombat: No usable abilities found. Start combat or enable Abilities Outside Combat in Action Bar settings.
illusive-combat-hud.empty.notInCombat: This token is not in the active combat.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipRollsDe: Roll ability checks, skills, and saving throws.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.noRollOpti: No ability checks, skills, or saves are available.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.macroManag: Shift+click to change, Alt+click to clear
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.joinedComb: {name} joined the encounter. Start combat from the turn tracker when ready.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.targetPick: Left-click tokens to mark or unmark targets (does not change your selected token).
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.restUnavai: Rest is not available for this actor.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.restDuring: Rest is unavailable while combat is active.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.notInComba: This token is not in combat.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.movementPr: Choose the token's current movement type.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.noMovement: No movement types are available for this token.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.noStatusOp: No status effects are available for this token.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.assignStat: Open the token configuration sheet to assign effects.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipSheetDe: Open this character's full sheet to edit stats, inventory, and features.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipConfigu: Open token configuration for vision, size, disposition, and display settings.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipLightDe: Choose a light preset, or Custom to set your own bright/dim radii.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.lightNotCo: No light radius saved. Set Bright or Dim Light on the token Light tab, then toggle again.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.lightCusto: Set bright and dim light radii for this token.
Set at least one of Bright or Dim above 0.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipMovemen: Choose walk, fly, swim, or other movement types for this token.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipVisibil: Toggle whether this token is visible to players.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipLeaveCo: Remove this token from the active encounter without ending combat for everyone.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipCombatR: Join the encounter or end your turn when it is your turn.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipCombatD: Waiting for combat to start or for your turn.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipEnterCo: Only the GM can start combat. Ask the GM to start the encounter to join combat.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.hpAmountIn: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.hpTempNotH: Temp HP is already {current}. Enter a higher amount (temp HP does not stack).
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipDeathSa: {success} successes, {failure} failures. Click the portrait to roll, or click a pip to set saves manually.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipPassive: Passive skill scores for this character.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipGemFilt: Show {section} abilities in the center panel.
illusive-combat-hud.actionBar.tipGemAvai: This economy type is still available.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.enableBossB: Show cinematic boss health bars configured per scene. GMs configure actors from the Token scene controls.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.menus.bossB: HP paths, wounds mode, bar position reset, and style configuration.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.bossBarRese: Reset the position of the Boss Bar to the default.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.bossBarCurr: Data path to the current HP of an actor.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.bossBarMaxH: Data path to the max HP of an actor.
illusive-combat-hud.settings.bossBarWoun: If your system uses wounds instead of hit points, enable this option.
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.settings.cur: Data path to the current HP of an actor.
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.settings.max: Data path to the max HP of an actor.
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.settings.res: Reset the position of the Boss Bar to the default.
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.settings.wou: If your system uses wounds instead of hit points, enable this option.
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.bar-style-co: Are you sure you want to delete this style?
illusive-combat-hud.bossBar.boss-bar-con: No actors selected or present in the scene.
No scene available. Please view a scene and try again.
